items.headline: Is Albemarle Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?
items.snippet: ALB is currently 48.9% below its 52-week high of $221, reached on June 7, 2026. Shares of ALB have declined 20.2% year-to-date. ALB has traded below its 200-day moving average since late June and slipped below its 50-day moving average in early September.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 7.8% and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB), the world's largest lithium supplier, reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike.
